questions.questionText: Jim _____________ a book at the moment.
questions.explanation: Dấu hiệu thời gian "at the moment" (ngay lúc này) chỉ hành động đang diễn ra tại thời điểm nói -> dùng thì Hiện tại tiếp diễn: S + am/is/are + V-ing (Jim is reading).

questions.questionText: Bich sometimes ____________chicken noodle soup for breakfast.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ tần suất "sometimes" diễn tả thói quen lặp đi lặp lại -> thì Hiện tại đơn. Chủ ngữ "Bich" là ngôi thứ 3 số ít nên động từ have chia thành has.

questions.questionText: My mother____________the responsibility for running the household.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ cố định (collocation): "take the responsibility for (doing) sth" = chịu trách nhiệm làm việc gì (quán xuyến gia đình).

questions.questionText: I'm lucky to have such a(n)__________ brother who always gives me help when I need it.
questions.explanation: Vị trí cần điền đứng trước danh từ "brother" cần một tính từ miêu tả tính cách. "supportive" (adj) mang nghĩa luôn sẵn lòng hỗ trợ, ủng hộ người khác.

questions.questionText: Doing chores as a family will help strengthen ____________.
questions.explanation: Collocation trọng tâm Unit 1: "strengthen family bonds" = thắt chặt / gắn kết tình cảm gia đình. (generation gap: khoảng cách thế hệ; family trees: phả hệ; family values: giá trị gia đình).

questions.questionText: My eldest son is strong enough to do the___________ for the family.
questions.explanation: Collocation: "do the heavy lifting" = làm công việc nặng nhọc đòi hỏi thể lực. Cụm "strong enough" (đủ khoẻ) bổ trợ chỉ việc mang vác nặng.

questions.questionText: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the word(s) CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined word(s): <u>Domestic</u> chores will no longer be a burden thanks to the inventions of laborsaving devices.
questions.explanation: domestic (adj: thuộc về trong nhà, gia đình) đồng nghĩa với household. "Domestic chores" = "Household chores" (việc nhà). (Official: chính thức; Foreign: nước ngoài; Schooling: học vấn).

questions.questionText: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the word(s) OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word(s): When having days off, he always helps his wife <u>tidy up</u> the house.
questions.explanation: tidy up (dọn dẹp ngăn nắp, gọn gàng) trái nghĩa với mess up (làm bừa bộn, lộn xộn). (clear up: dọn dẹp sạch; look up: tra cứu; cheer up: cổ vũ, làm vui lên).

questions.questionText: Women have been moving into the workforce not only for career satisfaction (11) ______ for the income.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc liên từ tương quan: "not only ... but also ..." (không những ... mà còn ...).

questions.questionText: Some women return to work soon after giving birth because they know that most employers are not sympathetic to working mothers (12) ______ wish to take time off to be with their young children.
questions.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ "who" thay thế cho danh từ chỉ người "working mothers" và làm chủ ngữ cho mệnh đề quan hệ phía sau (wish to take time off).

questions.questionText: Some people still think that a “good mother” is one who gives (13) ______ work to stay home with her children.
questions.explanation: Cụm động từ: "give up sth" = từ bỏ / ngừng làm việc gì. "give up work" = từ bỏ công việc.

questions.questionText: In most families with working mothers, each person (14) ______ a more active role in the household.
questions.explanation: Collocation: "play a role in sth" = đóng vai trò trong việc gì.

questions.questionText: These positive outcomes are most likely when the working mother feels valued and (15) ______ by family, friends, and co-workers.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc song hành với liên từ "and": sau "feels", tính từ / phân từ hai mang nghĩa bị động "valued and supported" (cảm thấy được trân trọng và được ủng hộ).

questions.questionText: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT true?

options.text: Chores can help children feel proud and happy.
Chores help children practice patience and self-control.
Chores prepare children for independent life in the future.
Chores make children better at playing sports.

questions.explanation: Bài viết đề cập: đoạn 2 nói về rèn luyện tính kiên nhẫn và tự chủ (B đúng); đoạn 3 nói về cảm thấy tự hào, hạnh phúc (A đúng) và chuẩn bị cho cuộc sống độc lập (C đúng). Bài viết không hề đề cập việc làm việc nhà giúp trẻ chơi thể thao giỏi hơn (D sai).

questions.questionText: The word <u>them</u> in the passage refers to ____.
questions.explanation: Từ "them" ở đoạn 2 ("setting the table or sorting clothes helps <u>them</u> practice following steps...") quy chiếu về đối tượng "children" được nhắc ở câu đầu đoạn ("Doing chores also teaches children...").

questions.questionText: The word <u>confidence</u> in the passage is opposite in meaning to____.
questions.explanation: confidence (sự tự tin, niềm tin vào bản thân) trái nghĩa với fear (sự sợ hãi, e ngại, thiếu tự tin). (courage, bravery: lòng dũng cảm; strength: sức mạnh).

questions.questionText: According to the passage, which of the following is TRUE about chores?

options.text: They give children routines and teach new skills.
They only give children simple routines without any skills.
They prevent children from feeling proud of themselves.
They are too difficult for toddlers to start with.

questions.explanation: Bài đọc chỉ ra việc làm việc nhà rèn nề nếp và dạy các kỹ năng sống mới ("learn important life skills", "train kids to wait for rewards", "practice following steps and managing time") -> Phương án A đúng. Các phương án B, C, D đều trái ngược với nội dung bài.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the best title for the passage?

options.text: The importance of chores for kids

questions.explanation: Toàn bộ bài viết tập trung phân tích những lợi ích toàn diện và tầm quan trọng của việc để con trẻ làm việc nhà đối với sự phát triển nhân cách và kỹ năng ("The importance of chores for kids").

questions.questionText:
Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the best arrangement of utterances to make a meaningful exchange:
a. Jack: That’s great! Helping with chores shows respect and builds strong family bonds.
b. Lucy: Yes, I often do the laundry and tidy up the kitchen. My parents really appreciate it.
c. Jack: Hey Lucy, do you help your parents with the household chores?
questions.explanation: Trật tự hội thoại mạch lạc: c (Jack mở lời hỏi Lucy có giúp bố mẹ làm việc nhà không) -> b (Lucy trả lời khẳng định và kể những việc mình làm) -> a (Jack nhận xét tích cực về việc đó).

questions.questionText:
Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the best arrangement of sentences to make a meaningful letter:
Dear Win,
a. I'm incredibly grateful for all the love and laughter they bring into my life.
b. We always have such a great time together, whether we're sharing a meal or just chatting.
c. They are truly my rock and constant source of support. 
d. I hope this letter finds you well. 
e. I was just thinking about how much my family means to me lately. 
I hope you're doing well and enjoying time with your own loved ones too!
Warmly,
Huy

sections.title: II. READING - PART 2: READING COMPREHENSION
sections.passageTitle: The Meaning of Family and Healthy Relationships
sections.instruction: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet to indicate the correct answer to each of the questions.
sections.passage:
We first learn about loving and caring relationships from our families. Family is defined as a domestic group of people with some degree of kinship - whether through blood, marriage, or adoption. Ideally, each child is nurtured, respected, and grows up to care for others and develop strong and healthy relationships. This does not mean that it is always easy to make and keep friends; it just means that we share the goal of having strong relationships.

"Family" includes your <u>siblings</u> and parents, as well as relatives who you may not interact with every day, such as your cousins, aunts, uncles, grandparents, and stepparents. These are probably the people you are closest to and with whom you spend the most time. Having healthy relationships with your family members is both important and difficult.

Families in the 21st century come in all shapes and sizes: traditional, single parent, blended (more than one family together in the same house), and gay and lesbian parents - just to name a few. No matter the "type" of family you have, there are going to be highs and lows - good times and bad. Many times, however, families become blocked in their relationships by hurt, anger, mistrust, and confusion. <u>These</u> are natural and normal, and few families do not have at least a few experiences with them. The worst time, for most families, is during a divorce. By making a few simple changes in the way we look at the world and deal with other people, it is possible to create happier, more stable relationships. Families need to be units of mutual caring and support; they can be sources of lifelong strength for all individuals.
(Adapted from pamf.org)

questions.explanation: spotlessly có trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ nhất (/ˈspɒtləsli/), các từ còn lại có trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ 2: experience (/ɪkˈspɪəriəns/), society (/səˈsaɪəti/), responsible (/rɪˈspɒnsəbl/).

questions.questionText: Listen! Someone ______________.
questions.explanation: Dấu hiệu câu mệnh lệnh cảm thán "Listen!" chỉ hành động đang xảy ra tại thời điểm nói -> thì Hiện tại tiếp diễn. Đại từ bất định "Someone" làm chủ ngữ số ít nên dùng "is singing".

questions.questionText: I usually __________ to school by bus.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ tần suất "usually" diễn tả thói quen thường nhật -> thì Hiện tại đơn. Chủ ngữ "I" đi với động từ nguyên thể: "go".

questions.questionText: My responsibility is to wash the dishes and ______ the rubbish.
questions.explanation: Cụm động từ: "put out the rubbish" (hoặc take out the rubbish) = đem rác ra ngoài đổ.

questions.questionText: After eating dinner, I have to do the ____________and then do my homework every day.
questions.explanation: Cụm danh từ cố định: "do the washing-up" (danh từ không đếm được) = việc rửa bát đĩa sau bữa ăn.

questions.questionText: Preparing and cooking meals are some of the essential __________for teens.
questions.explanation: Từ vựng Unit 1: "life skills" = kỹ năng sống (tự lập, nấu ăn, dọn dẹp). (soft skills: kỹ năng mềm; table manners: quy tắc bàn ăn; netiquette: văn hoá ứng xử trên mạng).

questions.questionText: When I lived in this city, I used to shop for ____________at this supermarket.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ: "shop for groceries" = đi mua sắm hàng tạp phẩm, thực phẩm gia đình.

questions.questionText: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the word(s) CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined word(s): Doing housework at a young age provides children with <u>necessary</u> life skills.
questions.explanation: necessary (cần thiết, thiết yếu) đồng nghĩa với essential. (extra: thêm vào; unimportant: không quan trọng; useless: vô dụng).

questions.questionText: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the word(s) OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word(s): Showing gratitude for the little things in life <u>strengthens</u> family relationships and promotes a positive atmosphere.
questions.explanation: strengthen (làm mạnh thêm, củng cố, tăng cường) trái nghĩa với decrease (làm suy giảm, sụt giảm). (enhances, improves: nâng cao, cải thiện - từ đồng nghĩa).

questions.questionText: It’s great fun, but it’s not always easy (11) __________ in a large family.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc: "It is (not) + adj + to-V". Trong 4 phương án, chỉ có "to be" và "to own" có dạng to-infinitive, và "to be in a large family" mang nghĩa sống/ở trong một đại gia đình.

questions.questionText: ...so we never have breakfast as a family. (12) __________, we always eat dinner at home; sometimes we watch TV together.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ liên kết "However" (Tuy nhiên) đứng đầu câu sau có dấu phẩy biểu thị ý tương phản giữa việc không ăn sáng cùng nhau và luôn ăn tối cùng nhau.

questions.questionText: My brothers and I often argue about (13) __________ to watch on TV.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc từ để hỏi + to-V: "what to watch" = xem cái gì trên TV.

questions.questionText: They help me (14) __________ my homework, too.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc: "help somebody with something" = giúp ai việc gì.

questions.questionText: I love him, but I think I’m too (15) __________ with him.
questions.explanation: Sau "am too" cần tính từ. Cụm: "be patient with somebody" = kiên nhẫn, nhẫn nại với ai. (patience là danh từ; patiently là trạng từ; impatient là thiếu kiên nhẫn).

questions.questionText: Ideally, each child is nurtured, respected, and grows up________.

options.text: to keep in touch with the people around them.
to keep a track of the people around them.
to be familiar with the people around them.
to be concerned about the people around them.

questions.questionText: What does the word <u>These</u> in paragraph 3 refer to?
questions.explanation: Trong bài viết: "...families become blocked in their relationships by hurt, anger, mistrust, and confusion. <u>These</u> are natural and normal...". Đại từ "These" thay thế cho các trạng thái cảm xúc (feelings) tiêu cực vừa liệt kê: hurt, anger, mistrust, confusion.

questions.questionText: According to the passage, which example below is probably NOT TRUE about the definition of family?

questions.questionText: Which of the following is closest in meaning to <u>siblings</u> in paragraph 2?
questions.explanation: sibling (danh từ) = anh chị em ruột (brothers and sisters).

questions.questionText: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.text: The importance of sharing housework in a family.
The importance of having children in a family.
The role of members in a family.

questions.explanation: Bài đọc xuyên suốt tập trung luận bàn về định nghĩa gia đình và việc nuôi dưỡng các mối quan hệ lành mạnh, bền vững giữa các thành viên ("The healthy relationships among members in a family").

questions.questionText:
Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the best arrangement of utterances to make a meaningful exchange:

Dear Grandma,

sections.instruction: Read the following passage carefully and then choose the best option to fit each numbered blank (from 11 to 15).
sections.passage:
Recycling is important in today’s world if we want to leave this planet for future generations. It is good for the environment (11) ___________ we are making new products from the old products which are of no use to us. Recycling begins at home. If you are not throwing (12) ___________ any of your old products and instead utilizing them for something new, then you are actually recycling.

When you think of recycling, you should really think about the whole idea: reduce, reuse and recycle. We’ve been careless up to this point with the way we've treated the Earth, and it’s time to change, not just the way we do things but the way we think. Recycling is good for the environment; in a sense, we are using old and waste products (13) ___________ are of no use and then converting them back to the same new products. Since we are saving resources and sending less trash to landfills, it helps in reducing air and water (14) ___________ .

With each passing day, the population is increasing. With that, the quantity of waste produced is also increasing manifolds. The more waste is produced, the more space is required to (15) ___________ this waste. Now, it must be remembered that the space available on earth is very limited, and it is obviously up to us to use it judiciously.

sections.passageTitle: Soil Degradation and Its Threats to Human Life
sections.instruction: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet to indicate the correct answer to each of the questions.
sections.passage:
More than a third of the world’s soil is endangered, according to a recent UN report. If we don’t slow the decline, all farmable soil could be gone in 60 years. Since soil grows 95% of our food, and sustains human life in other more surprising ways, that is a huge problem. A single gram of healthy soil might <u>contain</u> 100 million bacteria, as well as other microorganisms such as viruses and fungi, living amid decomposing plants and various minerals.

That means soils do not just grow our food, but are the source of nearly all our existing antibiotics, and could be our best hope in the fight against antibiotic-resistant bacteria. Soil is also an ally against climate change: as microorganisms within soil digest dead animals and plants, they lock in their carbon content, holding three times the amount of carbon as does the entire atmosphere. Soils also store water, preventing flood damage: in the UK, damage to buildings, roads and bridges from floods caused by soil degradation costs £233 million every year.

If the soil loses <u>its</u> ability to perform these functions, the human race could be in big trouble. The danger is not that the soil will disappear completely, but that the microorganisms that give it its special properties will be lost. And once this has happened, it may take the soil thousands of years to recover.
(Adapted from https://www.ieltsfighter.com)

questions.explanation: "household appliances" = các thiết bị gia dụng (đèn, quạt, tivi, tủ lạnh...). Động từ "turn off" (tắt) đi kèm phù hợp nhất với các thiết bị gia dụng khi không sử dụng để tiết kiệm năng lượng.

questions.questionText: More people _________ a green lifestyle because it is good for the environment.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ cố định (collocation): "adopt a green lifestyle" = tiếp nhận / theo đuổi lối sống xanh thân thiện với môi trường.

questions.explanation: Từ gạch chân "<u>impact</u>" có nghĩa là tác động, ảnh hưởng. Từ đồng nghĩa gần nhất là "effect" (tác động, ảnh hưởng). Advantage = lợi ích; consequence = hậu quả; circumstance = hoàn cảnh.

questions.questionText: If you are not throwing (12) ___________ any of your old products and instead utilizing them for something new, then you are actually recycling.
questions.explanation: Cụm động từ: "throw away" = vứt đi, bỏ đi.

questions.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ thay thế cho danh từ chỉ vật "old and waste products" và đóng vai trò làm chủ ngữ cho mệnh đề quan hệ phía sau là "that" (hoặc "which").

questions.questionText: Since we are saving resources and sending less trash to landfills, it helps in reducing air and water (14) ___________ .

I come from a town where people really care about the environment. We don’t want to live in a place (11) __________ is dirty and full of pollution. So, we try our best to keep it clean. It isn’t always easy, but we do the best we can! There are many places and people that are working together to help make our town and the world better.

At the markets, many of the owners and managers have started to (12) __________ single-use plastics because they cause too much pollution. I think that more and more people are trying to save the environment, which is great. My school has also been trying to reduce the amount of (13) __________ it is causing. All the students and teachers are trying their best. We are all also trying to recycle our trash, so that it doesn’t go to waste. There are still some things we can do better, but I’m happy with how hard we are all trying.

Even at home, we are trying our best. We try to save as much water as we can, and use as little electricity as possible. It isn’t only good (14) ________ the environment, but also for us! If we use less water and electricity, we will save money!

I guess what I’m trying to show you is that the solution to global warming and pollution is working together. We can all do our best individually, (15) __________ as a team we can do an even better job!

sections.title: II. READING - PART 2: READING COMPREHENSION
sections.passageTitle: Why Is Green Living So Important?
sections.instruction: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet to indicate the correct answer to each of the questions.
sections.passage:
Many people go through life only thinking about their own well-being and that of those around them. In reality, the well-being of the environment is just as important in certain ways. Without a healthy and sustainable environment, their own health and ability to leave behind a sustainable planet to those who live after them is negatively affected. Therefore, two main environmental benefits can be realised with greener living.

Firstly, people can conserve natural resources. The natural resources that man has been enjoying are beginning to disappear. Due to population growth, it is estimated that the use of natural resources has more than tripled since 1970. At that rate, it is not difficult to see how these same resources will eventually become <u>depleted</u>. It is important to conserve those precious resources so that others after this generation can enjoy the same quality of living on this planet.

Secondly, people can reduce the harmful effects of climate change. Primarily due to human’s reliance on fossil fuels over the years, climate change is a real concern. People continue to release carbon dioxide into the atmosphere, further polluting the air. <u>This</u> is leading to dramatic changes in temperatures that need to be stopped. Greener living aims to do exactly that. For every person who makes an effort to reduce his or her carbon footprint in the world, climate change can begin to become less of a concern over time.
(Adapted from: https://planetrenewed.com/why-is-green-living-so-important-we-find-out)

sections.instruction: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the best arrangement of utterances or sentences to make a meaningful exchange or text in each of the following questions.

sections.title: III. WRITING - PART 2: TỰ LUẬN (SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION)
sections.instruction: Rewrite each of the following sentences as long as the meaning is unchanged, using the given words. (Học sinh tự gõ câu viết lại vào ô trống bên dưới).

questions.questionText: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet to indicate the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress.
questions.explanation: maintain có trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ 2 (/meɪnˈteɪn/), các từ còn lại có trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ nhất: greenhouse (/ˈɡriːnhaʊs/), lifestyle (/ˈlaɪfstaɪl/), nature (/ˈneɪtʃər/).

questions.questionText: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet to indicate the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress.
questions.explanation: awareness có trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ 2 (/əˈweənəs/), các từ còn lại có trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ nhất: difference (/ˈdɪfrəns/), instrument (/ˈɪnstrəmənt/), character (/ˈkærəktər/).

questions.questionText: Money ______ to the homeless shelter by Larry.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ "Money" (tiền) là danh từ không đếm được chỉ vật, có tác nhân "by Larry" nên phải chia ở thể bị động: was/were + V3/ed. Bị động quá khứ đơn: "was donated".

questions.questionText: “Look at those dark clouds!“ - “Yes, it ____ in some minutes.”
questions.explanation: Dự đoán sự việc sắp xảy ra dựa trên bằng chứng / dấu hiệu trực quan ở hiện tại ("Look at those dark clouds!") dùng cấu trúc tương lai gần "be going to + V": "is going to rain".

questions.questionText: You should cut down ________ electricity usage to reduce your carbon footprint.
questions.explanation: Cụm động từ cố định: "cut down on sth" = cắt giảm việc tiêu thụ / sử dụng cái gì (ví dụ: cắt giảm lượng điện tiêu thụ để giảm lượng phát thải carbon).

questions.questionText: We buy _______ food at the farmers' market. It costs a little bit more, but we think it's better for our health.
questions.explanation: Trước danh từ "food" cần một tính từ. Ngữ cảnh "better for our health" (tốt cho sức khỏe) và "at the farmers' market" chỉ thực phẩm hữu cơ ("organic food").

questions.questionText: Small changes in your daily habits can help reduce the ___________you produce.
questions.explanation: "carbon footprint" = dấu chân carbon (tổng lượng khí nhà kính phát thải do các hoạt động của con người). Cụm từ: "reduce the carbon footprint you produce".

questions.questionText: In Singapore, people try to ____ 80% of all waste.
questions.explanation: "recycle waste" = tái chế rác thải (xử lý rác thành vật liệu mới).

questions.questionText: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet to indicate the word(s) CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined word(s): People should actively participate in environmental events to <u>preserve</u> the planet for future generations
questions.explanation: Từ gạch chân "<u>preserve</u>" có nghĩa là bảo tồn, giữ gìn, bảo vệ. Từ đồng nghĩa gần nhất là "protect" (bảo vệ). Destroy = phá hủy; collect = thu gom; sort = phân loại.

questions.questionText: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet to indicate the word(s) OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word(s): The release of <u>harmful</u> chemicals into rivers can have severe consequences for the environment and human health.
questions.explanation: Từ gạch chân "<u>harmful</u>" có nghĩa là độc hại, gây hại. Từ trái nghĩa là "beneficial" (có lợi, hữu ích). Refillable = có thể làm đầy lại; damaging = gây tổn hại; fresh = tươi mới.

questions.questionText: We don’t want to live in a place (11) __________ is dirty and full of pollution.
questions.explanation: Mặc dù từ đứng trước là "a place", nhưng ngay phía sau ô trống là động từ "is dirty", do đó vị trí này cần một đại từ quan hệ đóng vai trò làm chủ ngữ (subject) thay thế cho vật -> dùng "that" (hoặc "which"). "where" là trạng từ quan hệ chỉ nơi chốn, sau "where" phải là một mệnh đề hoàn chỉnh (S + V).

questions.questionText: At the markets, many of the owners and managers have started to (12) __________ single-use plastics because they cause too much pollution.
questions.explanation: Vì đồ nhựa dùng một lần gây ra quá nhiều ô nhiễm ("because they cause too much pollution") nên các chủ cửa hàng và quản lý bắt đầu cấm sử dụng ("ban single-use plastics").

questions.questionText: My school has also been trying to reduce the amount of (13) __________ it is causing.
questions.explanation: Sau cụm "the amount of" cần một danh từ không đếm được: "pollution" (sự ô nhiễm). Cụm "the amount of pollution it is causing" = lượng ô nhiễm mà trường học gây ra.

questions.questionText: It isn’t only good (14) ________ the environment, but also for us!
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc so sánh tương ứng: "good for sth" (tốt cho cái gì). Vế sau có "but also for us" nên vị trí ô trống dùng "good for the environment".

questions.questionText: We can all do our best individually, (15) __________ as a team we can do an even better job!
questions.explanation: Hai mệnh đề có mối quan hệ tương phản đối lập: từng cá nhân nỗ lực nhưng khi là một tập thể sẽ làm tốt hơn nữa. Liên từ đẳng lập nối hai mệnh đề sau dấu phẩy là "but".

questions.questionText: Which of the following can be the best title for the passage?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 mở bài dẫn dắt: "Therefore, two main environmental benefits can be realised with greener living." Sau đó đoạn 2 trình bày lợi ích thứ nhất ("Firstly, people can conserve natural resources"), đoạn 3 trình bày lợi ích thứ hai ("Secondly, people can reduce the harmful effects of climate change"). Do đó tiêu đề phù hợp nhất là "The Benefits of Green Living" (Những lợi ích của lối sống xanh).

questions.questionText: The word “<u>depleted</u>” in paragraph 2 is CLOSEST in meaning to ________.
questions.explanation: Từ gạch chân "<u>depleted</u>" có nghĩa là bị cạn kiệt, suy giảm đến mức hết. Từ đồng nghĩa gần nhất là "run out" (cạn kiệt, hết sạch).

questions.questionText: The word “<u>This</u>” in paragraph 3 refers to________.

options.text: the activity of releasing carbon dioxide and causing air pollution
the harmful effect of climate change

questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 viết: "People continue to release carbon dioxide into the atmosphere, further polluting the air. <u>This</u> is leading to dramatic changes in temperatures that need to be stopped." Từ "<u>This</u>" thay thế cho toàn bộ hành động được nhắc ở câu trước: việc con người tiếp tục xả CO2 và gây ô nhiễm không khí.

questions.questionText: According to paragraph 2, natural resources ________.

options.text: are not precious to human on Earth
has been used more and more since 1970s

questions.explanation: Dẫn chứng ở đoạn 2: "Due to population growth, it is estimated that the use of natural resources has more than tripled since 1970." (Do sự gia tăng dân số, ước tính lượng tài nguyên thiên nhiên được sử dụng đã tăng hơn gấp ba lần kể từ năm 1970) -> tài nguyên thiên nhiên ngày càng được sử dụng nhiều hơn.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT TRUE according to the passage?

options.text: The well-being of the environment is as important as that of each person
Climate change is a problem because of the reliance on fossil fuels
Carbon dioxide contributes to air pollution
Climate change can only be stopped by actions of governments

questions.explanation: Thông tin trong bài ở cuối đoạn 3: "For every person who makes an effort to reduce his or her carbon footprint in the world, climate change can begin to become less of a concern over time." Mỗi cá nhân đều có thể góp phần làm giảm biến đổi khí hậu bằng cách giảm dấu chân carbon của mình, do đó nhận định D (chỉ có thể được ngăn chặn bằng hành động của chính phủ) là SAI so với bài đọc.

questions.questionText:
Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the best arrangement of utterances or sentences to make a meaningful exchange:
a. Liam: Thanks! I’ve also started using refillable containers at home and recycling more carefully.
b. Liam: I bring my own reusable bottle and lunch box every day to avoid plastic waste.
c. Sarah: That’s amazing, Liam! You’re really following a zero-waste lifestyle.
questions.explanation: Trật tự hợp lý: b (Liam kể về thói quen mang bình nước và hộp cơm dùng lại để tránh rác thải nhựa) -> c (Sarah khen ngợi lối sống zero-waste của Liam) -> a (Liam cảm ơn và chia sẻ thêm hành động tích cực khác). Trật tự đúng: b - c - a.

questions.questionText:
Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the best arrangement of utterances or sentences to make a meaningful text:
a. To help reduce this, people can bring reusable bags when shopping and use refillable water bottles.
b. Recycling is another important step in living green.
c. These small changes help limit plastic use and protect the environment.
d. It reduces pollution, saves natural resources like water and trees, and gives new life to used materials instead of sending them to landfills.
e. Plastic waste is a serious problem because it takes many years to break down.
questions.explanation: Trật tự phát triển logic: e (Nêu vấn đề rác thải nhựa phân hủy lâu) -> a ("To help reduce this" - biện pháp mang túi tái sử dụng và bình đựng nước) -> c ("These small changes" - tác dụng của những thay đổi nhỏ này) -> b (Chuyển ý sang tái chế: "Recycling is another important step...") -> d ("It" thay cho "Recycling" - nêu lợi ích của việc tái chế). Trật tự đúng: e - a - c - b - d.
